3110976.findings: Cut crystal vase, about 24 cm, with a flared silver rim collar engraved with a foliate monogram cartouche and a second silver collar around the foot. Fluted and ring-cut upper body over a hobnail (diamond) cut bulbous base, good quality hand cutting typical of c.1900 English or Continental work. No hallmark visible in either photo on rim or foot (marks may be on the inside or underside, not shown), so the sterling claim is unconfirmed. Seam visible in the foot collar.
3110976.condition: Silver tarnished. Some residue or old adhesive at the rim joint and possible small chips to the top edge of the crystal under the collar; a paper label remnant on the side. No obvious cracks seen.
3110976.reason: Antique double silver-mounted hobnail cut crystal vase with engraved monogram; worth checking for hallmarks, decent if sterling and undamaged.
3110976.marks_read: Engraved monogram on rim collar; no hallmarks visible

3111238.findings: Mixed tub lot of mainly circulated bronze: Australian pre-decimal kangaroo pennies and halfpennies (1950s visible), UK George VI and Elizabeth II pennies and halfpennies, South African and other world coins, some aluminium and cupronickel. Two Australian 1988 Parliament House aluminium-bronze $5 coins, Western Samoa 1976 $1 Montreal Olympics cupronickel in red card, Centenary of Federation medallion in card, a few coloured Australian $1/$2 type coins in 2x2 holders, coins in capsules, a token. Stanley Gibbons Postage Stamp Catalogue Part 1 British Commonwealth 1970 (worthless). No obvious pre-1946 silver identified in the photos, though a few small white coins cannot be read.
3111238.condition: Mostly well circulated, toned and dirty bronze; capsules and holders in fair order.
3111238.reason: Common circulated bronze and base-metal world coins plus a few modern commemoratives and an old stamp catalogue; little or no silver seen.
